name: AI-Boost 4.0 for Red Alert
description:
# AI-Boost 4.0 for Red Alert
Source update: 4 October 2026

AI-Boost 4.0 builds on AI-Boost 3.2b by Bast75 and xXMini FrankiXx.

Main updates:
- AI unit production responds to enemy armor, infantry, aircraft, and defenses.
- Economy recovery prioritizes replacing harvesters and restoring construction capability.
- Strategy selection checks feasible technology and naval placement, with automatic transitions when rushes are countered.
- Enemy threat information, per-house production budgets, and naval limits are refreshed correctly.
- Attack waves preserve harvesting, base expansion, teams, and units already fighting. Chrono Tanks check targets and landing cells.
- Nearby target selection retains the strongest eligible target.
- A sprite-renderer address-calculation defect that caused terrain-drawing startup crashes is repaired.

The repository includes build instructions and AI/renderer regression checks. Full live-match startup and competitive strength still require playtesting.

Source, configuration, release notes, and original mod credits:
https://github.com/xunboo/CnC_Remastered_Collection
author: Bast75
